readUpToLine.description: The last line of the Run's output read into these entries: pass it as `after` to read only what came since.

line.description: The line of the Run's output it came from, from 1.

part.description: Its place among the entries of that line, from 1.

text.description: A message's text; null for a tool call.

toolName.description: The tool called, for a tool call.

oneOf.description: What the tool was called with. One whose JSON was over 20 KB is cut: a string of its JSON's first 20 KB, with `toolInputCut` set.

toolResult.description: What the tool answered, once it has; cut to its first 20 KB, with `toolResultCut` set.

toolResultLine.description: The line its tool result came on, which a reader reading with `after` sees again.
